headings: Risk Assessment of Automated Treatment Planning
sources.text: Dr. Kelly Kisling Dr. Kisling’s research is focused on the development and clinical implementation of automated (knowledge-based) treatment planning in 3D conformal radiotherapy (3DCRT), in particular automated 3DCRT approaches in women undergoing adjuvant RT for breast cancer. Her research is complementary to other RMAS efforts focused on implementing automation in patients undergoing intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) and brachytherapy.
